instructions.content:
**Attire**
Standard security uniform in dark colors. High-visibility vest and closed-toe work boots are required at all times - this is an active construction site. Company/security ID visible. Carry a working flashlight for overnight patrols.

**Arrival**
Shift is 7:00 PM to 6:00 AM, seven nights per week.

Site: 3987 Pinehurst Ave, Springfield, IL 62701, Springfield, NC 10063 (RS Rockvale Hotel - active hotel construction site).

GATE IS LOCKED. Gate code is 1772. Lock the gate behind you once you are on site and keep it locked through the shift.

Site contact: Priya Castillo, +15550000150
Backup contact: Simone Brennan, +15550000151

Three site photos are attached to this job in the app. Open them before your first patrol - PHOTO 1 shows the front entrance and the overall layout.

Check in through the app as soon as you arrive. If the gate code does not work or you cannot get on site, call Calvis Overwatch immediately and do not leave the site.

FACILITIES ON SITE
- Porta potties are on site and the client has cleared you to use them.
- The construction trailer is LOCKED overnight. There is no indoor space, no shelter, and no break room available to you. Plan for a full 11 hours outdoors - bring water, food, and weather-appropriate gear.

**Duties**
PRIORITY - ACTIVE THEFT PROBLEM AT THIS SITE

Two known intruders have been entering this property after hours. Their entry point is the gap in the REAR (south) perimeter - NOT the front gate. See PHOTO 1: the arrows at the bottom of that image mark exactly where they come through. Their approach comes from the north along N Harrison Ave off I-40, shown in PHOTO 3. Weight your patrols toward the rear of the property.

ATTACHED PHOTOS
- PHOTO 1 - Overhead of the front of the site. Front entrance is labeled, and the arrows at the bottom mark the intruder entry point at the rear perimeter.
- PHOTO 2 - Rear of the site. Shows the staged pipe and metal stock that is the theft target, plus the trailers and equipment yard.
- PHOTO 3 - Wider satellite view showing the route the intruders take in from I-2949 Pinehurst Ave, Springfield, IL 62701.

SITE CAMERAS - YOU HAVE ACCESS TO THE FEEDS
The client has six cellular cameras on this site and has given Calvis officers access.

App: Defend by Tactacam (free, iOS and Android)
Login: person7@example.invalid
Password: Site1433

Camera positions
- THREE cameras cover the rear entry area where the two intruders have been coming through. These are your priority feeds.
- ONE on the southwest side, over the staged materials and the trailers.
- ONE at the construction trailer.
- ONE at the front entrance.

How to use them
- Check the feeds between patrols, weighted to the three rear-entry cameras and the southwest materials camera.
- The cameras SUPPLEMENT your patrols, they do not replace them. This is still a roaming foot patrol post. Do not sit and watch a phone instead of walking the site.
- If you see movement on a feed, do not walk up on it alone and do not confront anyone. Follow the intruder procedure below - 911 first, then Priya.
- Between you on the ground and the cameras recording, an incident produces both a witness and footage. That combination is what lets Cary PD actually act on it, so document carefully.
- These credentials belong to the client. Do not share them and do not use the account for anything outside this post.

This is a roaming foot patrol post. Do not stand at the gate or sit in one place.

PRIORITY AREAS
- Rear yard staged material: HDPE pipe and bundled metal/steel stock, visible in PHOTO 2. This is the primary theft target - highest value and easiest to carry off.
- The rear/south perimeter gap where the intruders have been coming through (PHOTO 1).
- Both structures (the long L-shaped building and the taller building). Check ground-level openings, doorways, and stairwells.
- Construction trailers and equipment staging areas.
- Tree lines along both sides of the property. These are soft edges - check them, do not assume the road frontage is the risk.

PATROL PATTERN
- Walk the full perimeter and both buildings at irregular intervals. Do not patrol on a fixed schedule - vary your timing so the pattern cannot be predicted.
- Use your flashlight and stay visible. Visible presence is the point.
- Log patrols and anything unusual in the app as you go.

IF YOU ENCOUNTER INTRUDERS
- Do not engage physically and do not pursue anyone off the property.
- Call 911 first, then Priya Castillo at +15550000150, then report it in the app.
- Photograph and document through the app only if it is safe to do so.

END OF SHIFT
File a written shift report in the app covering patrols completed, condition of the rear staged material, any activity at the rear perimeter, anything seen on the camera feeds, and anything the day crew should know.

site_notes.content: Following the arrests earlier in the day, wire coils were removed from the site and secured in the trailer with assistance from security. The rear perimeter gap — the known entry point — was monitored across all patrol rounds overnight with no further breach. Site contact Chris indicated additional fencing will be installed; professional replacement remains pending.

The rear perimeter gap was confirmed as the entry point used this shift: two suspects stepped over a small fence in the adjacent woods to access the site. Rockvale Police arrested both suspects on site and recovered stolen wire coils from the second floor. The main site perimeter fence was not damaged. Site contact Chris indicated additional fencing will be installed at the rear gap.

The temporary wooden gate blocking the rear perimeter gap was monitored throughout all twelve patrol rounds and confirmed holding. The guard reinforced the orange fence mitigation again at end of shift. The repair remains temporary; professional fence replacement is still needed.

Guard found the rear orange security fence damaged on arrival and repositioned it. A field repair was performed during the shift, described as 'fixed the best I could.' The fence was confirmed in place across all 11 patrol checks with no breach attempted overnight. The repair is temporary; a professional inspection and permanent replacement of the fence is needed.
Rear orange security fence damaged — professional replacement needed
Broken window panes noted again this shift; guard confirmed the condition to the incoming day crew. No change in status — repair has not yet been completed.

During the third patrol (~9:15 PM), 3–4 broken window panes were found at the lower level of the second or third building, near the porta potty leaning against the wall. Impact pattern is consistent with rocks thrown through — not shattered as if dropped. Damage appears pre-existing; no glass was heard breaking during any patrol this shift. Client should arrange inspection and repair.
